Как подключить Gmail — по шагам (2 минут: How to connect Gmail — step by step (2 minutes)
Включите двухэтапную аутентификацию, есл: Turn on 2-Step Verification if it is not on yet: myaccount.google.com → Security → 2-Step Verification. Without it Google won't let you create an app password.
В поле «Название приложения» напишите <b: Type JustDay as the app name and press “Create”.
Google покажет пароль из 16 букв в жёлто: Google shows a 16-letter password in a yellow box. Copy it (spaces are fine). It is shown only once.
Вставьте свой адрес Gmail и этот пароль: Paste your Gmail address and this password into the fields above and press “Connect”. If everything is right you'll see “Mail connected” and the number of inbox letters.
Проверьте голосом: «проверь почту». Пись: Try it by voice: “check my mail”. Letters are read and summarised by the local model; they never go to the cloud.
Не работает? «Неверный пароль» — создайт: Not working? “Wrong password” — create a new app password (an old one can't be viewed again). IMAP is always on in Gmail now, nothing to enable. To revoke access, delete the “JustDay” app password on the same page.
